g.text: Domain Model Excerpt - BCK10 Predefined Pizza Management
A PredefinedPizza is a Sellable Product,
not also a Pizza Component. It uses the
ProductId and Product composition. It has
no separate ID or second configuration.
BCK10 includes each component Product at most once.
Its quantity is 1 in this story; the per-size
consumption is defined separately by BCK08.
BCK05 owns Product identity and aggregate lifecycle.
and default Product composition through a BCK05-owned
application contract. All IDs remain Product IDs.
